m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Yo, you ready for some combat training? Let's start with a little friendly sparring. Don't worry, you ain't fighting me. I'm too old.
You're gonna spar with Qhreed. Yo, Qhreed, grab your mouthpiece!
Yo, go easy on the Wizard. We're all friends here, OK? Now, ring the bell Qhreed.
Eh, yo, you can say that again!
Ha, yeah. He's right, Wizard. You're quite the fighter. But you could be better. Come here. I've got something for you.
When it comes to fighting, I thought I knew all there was to know, ya know? But you've got moves I ain't never seen before.
Yo, but just cuz I can't show you any new moves don't mean I can't help you get better. Here, I want you to have this...
This gear is going to boost your PIP Recovery when casting an odd ranked spell.
You know, like if you have six PIPs and cast a rank five spell, you get a chance to recover that unused PIP. Yo, you're welcome!
Eh, you know, now that we've punched up your game, you ready for round two?
Yo, how ya doin'? You're a Wizard, ain't you? You're not supposed to be here. But don't sweat it. That ain't none of my business.
I'm not in the Army anymore. Now I train soldiers in the Serpentine Science - that's combat, ya know? Got my own Gym and everything.
And I tell ya, I'm the best trainer that ever lived, but I'm getting squeezed out by that scale-brain, Qhreese, from the Kobra Kai Dojo.
They've knocked most of my students out of commission! But Yo, you look tough. You interested in training in the Serpentine Science?
Yeah? Then come on down to my Gym and I'll show you a thing or two. Just keep an eye out for Kobra Kai, ya know.
Yo, with a student like you, my Gym might be able hold its own against Kobra Kai. But we'll have to train you in the Serpentine Science first.
